problem_statement: NextAdminHQ/nextjs-admin-dashboard (NextAdmin) is a Next.js 16 admin dashboard kit. The operations team wants a shared "Signal desk" status strip added to the widget zone of every operations surface. The strip sits directly beneath the overview KPI cards and shows a small operational read for the current window: four metric tiles (Open incidents, Sync latency, Live sessions, Error rate), a reading-window control with three ranges (Today / 7-day / 30-day), and a one-line readout naming the active window plus the recommended next step. Requirements: (1) the same Signal desk strip must appear in the widget zone of the dashboard (/), the Tables page (/tables) AND the Basic Chart page (/charts/basic-chart) via one shared component, so the operator sees one consistent read on every surface; (2) picking a reading window must update the tile values AND the readout LIVE, so switching to the 7-day range makes the readout say "Reading window: 7-day"; (3) the metric tiles must wrap with no horizontal overflow of the admin shell on a 390px phone; (4) the strip must match the existing NextAdmin card chrome (white rounded card, indigo accent, legible dark-on-light metric text), not collapse into an overlapping illegible band. Preserve the sidebar, header, overview cards, charts, tables, the static build and the auth pages; 0 console/network errors.
required_content: A shared 'Signal desk' status strip in the widget zone of the dashboard, tables and charts pages.
Four metric tiles: Open incidents, Sync latency, Live sessions, Error rate.
A reading-window control with Today / 7-day / 30-day ranges.
A live readout naming the active reading window and the recommended next step.
The tile row wraps with no horizontal overflow on a 390px phone.
The strip matches the NextAdmin card chrome (white rounded card, indigo accent, legible metric text).
design_constraints: Reuse the existing NextAdmin card styling (rounded white card, shadow-1, indigo #5750f1 accent, dark-on-light text).
The Signal desk strip belongs in the dashboard widget zone beneath the overview KPI cards, not a modal or hero.
The reading-window readout must re-sync to the selected range on every click (no stale/frozen readout).
The metric tiles must wrap on narrow viewports; never a fixed-width nowrap track that overflows the phone.
The same shared component must render on the dashboard, tables and charts surfaces.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and mobile_initial protect the original NextAdmin shell (sidebar, header, overview KPI cards) and the new Signal desk strip on the dashboard before any interaction.
desktop_signal_focus scrolls the Signal desk strip into view and verifies the default Today window (four metric tiles) renders as legible wrapped tiles matching the card chrome.

desktop_signal_week and desktop_signal_month click the 7-day and 30-day reading-window controls and require the readout to re-sync to the selected window (Reading window: 7-day / 30-day); a stale readout that never updates is a failed interaction.
desktop_tables_route and desktop_charts_route verify the shared Signal desk strip is echoed onto the Tables and Basic Chart pages so the operational read stays consistent across every surface.
tablet_signal_focus and mobile_signal_focus require the Signal desk metric tiles to wrap without horizontal overflow of the admin shell at tablet and phone widths.

change_completion: The trust strip keeps its four tiles and their exact labels/values after the repair.
Mobile sign-in and sign-up (initial and filled) no longer overflow horizontally.
Desktop strip and auth card are preserved without regression.
The Google button, email/password form, remember-me control, and sign-in/sign-up cross-links remain functional.
design_consistency: The repaired strip keeps NextAdmin's soft-panel tiles, indigo accent, and card rhythm.
Only the strip's responsive reflow changes; the rest of the auth entry is untouched.
The result still reads as the NextAdmin auth entry, not a re-themed page.
regression: The built app still serves the /auth/sign-in and /auth/sign-up routes.
The Google button, email/password form, and cross-page links behave as before.
responsive: 390px mobile sign-in and sign-up (initial and filled) have no horizontal overflow beyond the 24px tolerance.
The trust tiles wrap and flex cleanly on narrow viewports without clipping content.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Next.js 16 / better-auth Repair task. A trust-reassurance strip added beneath the auth form on the /auth/sign-in and /auth/sign-up entry pages ships a fixed-width, non-wrapping tile row that overflows the 390px mobile viewport by ~150px while fitting desktop. The single-file repair (src/components/Auth/TrustStrip/truststrip.css) lets the row wrap and the tiles flex, eliminating the mobile horizontal overflow while keeping content and DOM byte-identical across all three legs, so the no_horizontal_overflow gate on the mobile states is the sole differentiator. The theme's native mx-auto w-[570px] auth-column overflow was relaxed to w-full max-w-[570px] identically across all legs as declared build infrastructure so the planted strip defect is the sole overflow source.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: NextAdmin is a Next.js 16 admin dashboard kit with a real widget-zone dashboard (overview KPI cards, charts, tables) across multiple admin routes, making it a natural host for a shared Signal desk status strip with a live reading-window control — a cross-page dashboard KPI/workflow lever.
